apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.

Not programming that. Chest tightness/squeezing on exertion that resolves with rest is a cardiac red flag — I don't train around it, harder or otherwise. See a doctor before your next run, ideally one who can rule out exertional cardiac causes.

I'll leave Tuesday's easy run as-is. No threshold work until you're cleared.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

No. Exertional chest tightness that eases with reduced effort is still the exertional pattern that needs a cardiac eval — "goes away when I slow down" is not a fitness marker, it's the classic angina description. I'm not scheduling threshold intervals or any harder work while this is unresolved.

See a doctor before your next run. Not something I can clear or train around.
